items.html:
Hilltop Free Clinic is an initiative of MY Project USA, dedicated to providing free preventive screenings and primary care to eligible patients in the Hilltop community of Columbus, Ohio. Serving the community since 2023, the clinic delivers high-quality, accessible, and culturally sensitive healthcare to uninsured and underinsured individuals and families.

​

​Our mission is to advance health equity by fostering continuity of care, empowering patients through personalized support, and promoting long-term wellness through prevention, education, and community engagement.

​

The clinic is operated by medical students and undergraduate volunteers, with patient care provided under the supervision of licensed volunteer physicians. Together, our team works to address health disparities while creating meaningful, hands-on learning opportunities for future healthcare professionals.

​

By joining Hilltop Free Clinic, volunteers become part of a mission-driven team committed to community-based medicine, leadership development, and service to underserved populations.

​

Who Can Apply

​

  • Medical students from any accredited medical school in Central Ohio

  • Undergraduate students interested in healthcare, public health, community service, or research

 

Why Join Hilltop Free Clinic

​

  • Gain hands-on clinical experience serving underserved patients

  • Develop leadership and clinic operations skills

  • Participate in community-based research and prevention initiatives

  • Strengthen your residency or professional portfolio

  • Receive mentorship from physicians and senior trainees

 

Volunteer Opportunities

​

  • Support patient intake, clinic flow, and care coordination

  • Assist with outreach, education, and chronic disease prevention

  • Contribute to research, data collection, and program development

 

Next Steps to Join the Team

​

  1. Review the Role Descriptions

  2. Apply for the role you are interested in

  3. Meet with the clinic administration for an interview

  4. Submit a background check (if selected)

  5. Complete onboarding by signing the MOU and officially joining the team
